newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bank, finance issues fall but good buys seen.
newsitem.headline: Thai bank, finance issues fall but good buys seen.

text.p: Brokers on Tuesday recommended investors to look for cheap bargains in the banking and finance sectors after some shares in the two counters fell to their daily limit after their trading suspension was lifted.

"Measures imposed by the central bank on Monday were severe but they would improve net profits of banks and finance firms in 1998. Investors ought to buy some of them as their prices are cheap," Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance told Reuters.

"Profits of finance firms and banks may not look impressive this year and they'll certainly improve in 1998. I suggest that it's time to buy large capitalised banks and finance firms which are subsidiaries of banks," Thanadech said.

In the banking sector, brokers recommended that investors buy Thailand's largest commercial bank, Bangkok Bank, Thai Farmers Bank and Siam Commercial Bank due to their good asset quality and net profit.

Large finance firms and subsidiaries of banks in which investors should invest included Dhana Siam Finance, National Finance and Securities, Krung Thai Thanakt, Phatra Thanakit, Asia Credit and Nava Finance and Securities, they said.
